ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram above is a life cycle of which organism?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a schematic diagram of a circular life cycle. In the upper left is the adult stage, a butterfly with orange and black wings, black edges with white spots; in the upper right is a single white egg on a leaf; in the lower right is a caterpillar with alternating yellow, black, and white stripes; in the lower left is a green pupa or chrysalis. Arrows in the image indicate the cyclical changes of these stages. Reasoning: egg → caterpillar/larva → green pupa → adult butterfly, this is the life cycle of a butterfly. The adult is orange and black with black edges bearing white spots, and the larva has yellow, black, and white stripes; these features match the monarch butterfly. Conclusion: This image is the life cycle of the monarch butterfly.
